about_the_game:
Blur the edge between chaos and control as you take to the streets at felonious speeds and carve out your space on the Estonian tuner scene. Power your own car with high-end performance parts, customize it with a range of body kits and challenge drivers from all subsets of car culture to races of ever-increasing reward, risk and renown. Welcome to your urban playground on the Baltic coastline.

Continental Car Culture

Seat yourself behind the wheel of more than 20 iconic vehicles. Hatchbacks, sedans, coupes, roadsters and station wagons are readily customized using the in-depth customization system. Build and curate your own custom-tailored collection of cars that represents you.

High Stakes

Jump directly into street races of various types, including but not exclusively such classics as Circuit, Sprint and Time Attack, to rise through the rankings of the Season, an annual underground street racing league.

Race for cash, or raise the stakes by putting your car on the line. Winner takes all, so consider the wager carefully before committing. Once the wager has been agreed upon, there's no going back and a loss may be potentially ruinous for your progress.

Market Access

The coastal location opens up opportunities to import and export goods across vast oceans. Utilize the services of the maritime Import/Export business to import hard-to-find parts and unique cars from foreign markets. Help finance your racing career and enjoy a break from the street racing by doing jobs on the export side, driving for whoever pays a fitting amount.

content_descriptors.notes: Ubiquitous presence of illegal and reckless driving.

short_description: Explore the capital of Estonia. Upgrade your car for performance, and customize it to make sure you win in style. Buy, sell and race a global lineup of cars with the goal of becoming the champion of the Season. Welcome to your urban playground on the Baltic coastline.
